newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordanian captain killed as army storms house.
newsitem.headline: Jordanian captain killed as army storms house.

text.p: A Jordanian army captain was shot dead near the northern region of Mafraq on Monday during a raid on a house sheltering illegal immigrants, the official Petra News Agency said.
It said soldiers stormed the house before dawn after they heard that "citizens from a sisterly Arab state who entered the country illegally" were staying there.
Mafraq town is around 10 miles (16 km) from Jordan's border with Syria. Mafraq governorate also extends east towards Iraq.
Petra said a man fired a pistol as he fled from the house, injuring Captain Youssef al-Daradka. Daradka was taken to hospital where he died shortly afterwards.
Thirteen men, including the gunman, were arrested.
